newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends up on inquiries, higher Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends up on inquiries, higher Tokyo.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices closed higher, supported by fresh inquiries from overseas and a higher Tokyo market, traders said.
But activity remained quiet due to lack of keen buying.
"There were some inquiries today from China and for European ports but they did not translate into deals," said one dealer.
A South Korean tender on Tuesday was also unlikely to yield any transaction. "At current prices, I don't think they are willing to pay," the dealer said.
Traders said the current low production period due to wintering was also keeping prices steady.
